cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

mechanism: Copy a marshal's route without recognizing the role, then turn last place into winning new categories of distance and effort using B's corrections.
confusable: Not just finding a silver lining: A must invite actual comparison on successively changed terms, and the copied error must create those terms.
comparison: Race distance and course knowledge rather than a prize's packaging size.
seedUse: Retains race loss/route appreciation and changing categories; adds copied marshal detour.
